result.description: A fictional 27-inch curved gaming monitor built for fast-paced play and immersive desktop use. It features a 240Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, WQHD resolution, adaptive sync support, and a matte anti-glare panel. The Arcadia is positioned as a premium display for esports setups, creative workstations, and multi-monitor rigs, with wide viewing angles, height adjustment, and DisplayPort plus HDMI connectivity.
result.title: Velox Arcadia 27in 240Hz Curved Display
